messages:
sanjay: heads up — scheduled maintenance for Europe dedicated pools on 2026-03-31 02:00 UTC. kernel + pinned-model swap. expected window ~30m. need statuspage snippet + customer email and in-app banner. @emily-support can you own comms?
marie: copy note — keep statuspage short and actionable. customers want impact and rollback plan. no jargon.
emily-support: yep will do. propose two email variants: technical (for platform engineers) and plain (for product owners). will post drafts here in a minute. who should get localized copies?
alex: FR+DE pls. i'll translate once you drop the english text.
luis-ops: operational checks: staging smoke + KV cache warmup. rollback plan: pin to model:v2.1.3 + route traffic to hosted-fallback if we hit sustained latency >300ms for 10m. also confirm we can toggle canaries via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: maintenance ticket MNT-2048 created. scheduled start 1775427600 end 1775429400. canaries set; will auto-hold on failed health checks.
status-bot: scheduled statuspage draft saved as /ops/status-drafts/MNT-2048 (visible to eng-platform, support).
marie: suggested statuspage text (short):

"Maintenance: Brief runtime upgrade in EU (Mar 31 02:00 UTC). You may see intermittent increased latency (up to ~5 minutes per region) while we swap kernels and pinned models. No customer data will be modified. We'll rollback automatically if latency or error rates exceed thresholds."

Keep link to docs and contact at end.
emily-support: dropping email subject + body variants now. please review: 

Subject (customer-friendly): "Planned maintenance — brief service update (Mar 31)"
Body (customer-friendly):
Hi —
We have a short scheduled maintenance for Redwood Inference on Mar 31 at 02:00 UTC affecting EU dedicated pools. During a ~30 minute window you may notice brief latency spikes or short request throttling. There is no data loss expected and our automatic rollback will restore service if we detect regressions.
If you have critical SLAs, please reach out to support@redwood.ai and we can coordinate.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops

Subject (technical): "Planned runtime + model pin update — EU dedicated (Mar 31)"
Body (technical):
Heads up — we will apply a kernel update and swap pinned model variant for EU dedicated pools on Mar 31 02:00 UTC (window ~30m). Impact: transient latency bumps and per-request throttling for a few minutes while caches warm. Rollback: automated pin to model:v2.1.3 + routing to hosted-fallback if 95th latency >300ms for 10m or error-rate delta >1.5x baseline. Post-maintenance: we will publish perf deltas and rollout notes. Contact: support@redwood.ai or /eng-oncall.

alex: French draft (customer-friendly):
Objet: "Maintenance planifiée — mise à jour de service (31 mars)"
Corps:
Bonjour —
Nous effectuerons une courte maintenance le 31 mars à 02:00 UTC sur les pools dédiés EU. Fenêtre ~30 minutes. Vous pourriez constater de brèves augmentations de latence ou un throttling temporaire. Aucune perte de données prévue. Si vous avez des SLA critiques, contactez support@redwood.ai.
Merci.

luis-ops: confirm runbook tasks I want before T-2h: 1) snapshot config, 2) cache pre-warm job, 3) smoke tests, 4) alert thresholds set to post-maint baseline, 5) dev keys withdrawn for prod jobs. I'll post checklist to MNT-2048.
emily-support: posted drafts to /ops/status-drafts/MNT-2048 and created staged statuspage update. draft link: https://internal.redwood/ops/status-drafts/MNT-2048 (eng-only). scheduling customer broadcast 30m before window: tiered list (enterprise -> reserved -> self-serve).
marie: add a short statuspage snippet pointing to the email for details and to support for SLA-sensitive customers. eg: "See your inbox or contact support for targeted mitigation."
sanjay: perfect. action items: emily publish broadcast T-30m, luis run prechecks T-2h, deploy-bot hold canaries with auto-rollback, alex attach FR/DE to draft. post-maint we'll attach perf snapshots and release note.
deploy-bot: canary auto-hold enabled. will emit hold if health-check failure rate >0.5% over 3m or 95th latency >300ms.
status-bot: customer-facing statuspage entry queued for publish at T-35m for review.
emily-support: scheduled broadcast queued. i'll also push in-app banner 10m before window.
luis-ops: started precheck runbook. posting results in MNT-2048 thread as soon as green.
marie: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. final ask — please keep replies short in this thread and use MNT-2048 for logs and post-maint notes.
sanjay: closing this planning thread. we'll reconvene if any holds trigger.
